description.en: Smooth naked axes arch upward from creeping rhizomes and bear elongate terminal sporangia.
description.zh: 光滑裸轴从匍匐根茎拱起，末端带长形孢子囊。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Aglaophyton majus; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Aglaophyton majus 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Creeping arch-and-fork construction and spindle-like capsules differ from Cooksonia's upright expanded caps.
distinctness.zh: 匍匐拱形分枝及纺锤状囊体区别于Cooksonia的直立扩张顶囊。

modeling_brief.en: Use low polygon tubes for the horizontal network and elongate capsules; branch rhythm is an artistic simplification.
modeling_brief.zh: 用低面数管体构成水平网络和长囊；分枝节奏为美术简化。

uncertainty: Formerly Rhynia major; not an additional Rhynia asset or a modern vascular plant.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.
